name: SOC 2
description: Trust Services Criteria for Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality and Privacy.

controls.title: Integrity and ethical values
controls.objective: The entity demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values.

controls.title: Board oversight
controls.objective: The board exercises independent oversight of internal control.

controls.title: Organisational structure
controls.objective: Management establishes structures, reporting lines, authorities and responsibilities.

controls.title: Commitment to competence
controls.objective: The entity attracts, develops and retains competent people.

controls.title: Accountability
controls.objective: The entity holds individuals accountable for their control responsibilities.

controls.title: Relevant information
controls.objective: The entity obtains and uses relevant, quality information to support internal control.

controls.title: Internal communication
controls.objective: The entity communicates internal-control information internally.

controls.title: External communication
controls.objective: The entity communicates relevant information to external parties.

controls.title: Objectives
controls.objective: The entity specifies objectives clearly enough to identify and assess related risks.

controls.title: Risk identification
controls.objective: The entity identifies and analyses risks to achieving its objectives.

controls.title: Fraud risk
controls.objective: The entity considers the potential for fraud when assessing risk.

controls.title: Change risk
controls.objective: The entity identifies and assesses changes that could impact internal control.

controls.title: Ongoing evaluations
controls.objective: The entity performs ongoing and separate evaluations of its controls.

controls.title: Deficiency communication
controls.objective: The entity evaluates and communicates control deficiencies for remediation.

controls.title: Control selection
controls.objective: The entity selects and develops control activities that mitigate risk.

controls.title: Technology controls
controls.objective: The entity selects and develops general control activities over technology.

controls.title: Policy deployment
controls.objective: The entity deploys control activities through policies and procedures.

categories.name: CC6 - Logical and Physical Access Controls

controls.title: Access security
controls.objective: Logical access security software and infrastructure protect information assets.

controls.title: User provisioning
controls.objective: New internal and external users are registered and authorised before access is granted.

controls.title: Least privilege
controls.objective: Access is granted based on roles and least privilege, and reviewed periodically.

controls.title: Physical access
controls.objective: Physical access to facilities and assets is restricted to authorised personnel.

controls.title: Asset disposal
controls.objective: Data and media are securely disposed of when no longer needed.

controls.title: Boundary protection
controls.objective: The entity protects against external threats at system boundaries.

controls.title: Transmission security
controls.objective: Information in transit is restricted and protected against unauthorised access.

controls.title: Unauthorised software
controls.objective: The entity prevents and detects the introduction of unauthorised software.

controls.title: Vulnerability management
controls.objective: Configurations are monitored and vulnerabilities are detected and remediated.

controls.title: Anomaly monitoring
controls.objective: System components are monitored for anomalies indicative of security events.

controls.title: Event evaluation
controls.objective: Security events are evaluated to determine whether they are incidents.

controls.title: Incident response
controls.objective: The entity responds to identified security incidents through a defined programme.

controls.title: Recovery
controls.objective: The entity recovers from identified security incidents.

controls.title: Change management
controls.objective: Changes to infrastructure, data, software and procedures are authorised, tested and approved.

controls.title: Business disruption
controls.objective: The entity mitigates risk from business disruptions.

controls.title: Vendor risk
controls.objective: The entity assesses and manages risks associated with vendors and partners.

controls.title: Capacity
controls.objective: Current and future capacity is managed to meet availability commitments.

controls.title: Environmental protection
controls.objective: Environmental protections, backups and recovery infrastructure are maintained.

controls.title: Recovery testing
controls.objective: Recovery plans are tested to support availability commitments.

controls.title: Confidential info identification
controls.objective: Confidential information is identified and maintained.

controls.title: Confidential info disposal
controls.objective: Confidential information is disposed of when no longer required.

controls.title: Processing objectives
controls.objective: The entity uses quality information about processing objectives.

controls.title: Input integrity
controls.objective: Inputs are complete and accurate.

controls.title: Processing integrity
controls.objective: Processing is complete, accurate and timely.

controls.title: Output integrity
controls.objective: Outputs are complete, accurate and delivered to the right recipients.

controls.title: Storage integrity
controls.objective: Stored inputs and outputs are complete and accurate.

controls.title: Privacy notice
controls.objective: The entity provides notice about its privacy practices.

controls.title: Choice and consent
controls.objective: The entity communicates choices available and obtains consent.

controls.title: Collection
controls.objective: Personal information is collected consistently with the privacy notice.

controls.title: Explicit consent
controls.objective: Explicit consent is obtained for sensitive personal information.

controls.title: Use
controls.objective: Personal information is used consistently with the privacy notice.

controls.title: Retention
controls.objective: Personal information is retained only as long as necessary.

controls.title: Disposal
controls.objective: Personal information is securely disposed of.

controls.title: Access
controls.objective: Data subjects can access their personal information.

controls.title: Correction
controls.objective: Data subjects can correct their personal information.

controls.title: Disclosure
controls.objective: Personal information is disclosed only per the privacy notice.

controls.title: Authorised disclosure
controls.objective: Disclosures are made only to authorised parties.

controls.title: Disclosure tracking
controls.objective: Unauthorised disclosures are recorded and addressed.

controls.title: Third-party agreements
controls.objective: Third parties are bound to equivalent privacy commitments.

controls.title: Third-party breaches
controls.objective: Third-party unauthorised disclosures are identified and addressed.

controls.title: Breach notification
controls.objective: Affected parties and authorities are notified of privacy breaches.

controls.title: Accounting of disclosures
controls.objective: The entity accounts for disclosures of personal information.

controls.title: Data quality
controls.objective: Personal information is accurate and complete for its intended use.

controls.title: Complaint handling
controls.objective: The entity manages privacy complaints and disputes.
